macro_events.causal_chain: Negative payrolls signal labor market cooling → market prices out Sept rate hike (odds 58% → 42%) → Treasury yields decline → dollar weakens → rate-sensitive growth stocks rerate higher (TEAM, TWLO, NET, PLTR) → housing/real estate benefit (XHB). Second-order: weaker consumer spending outlook pressures brick-and-mortar retail but benefits quality tech with recurring revenue models.
macro_events.analog: March 2024: weak payrolls → Fed signaled patience → SPY rallied 5% over 3 weeks as rate expectations repriced
macro_events.counterargument: Single-month volatility in payrolls is high; BLS revisions could flip the sign. If CPI Wednesday comes in hot, the Fed will prioritize inflation mandate over soft labor data.
macro_events.tickers_affected: TEAM▲ TWLO▲ NET▲ PLTR▲ SHOP▲ XHB▲ | XLE▼ (rate-driven dollar weakness pressures energy)

macro_events.event: CPI Release Wednesday Aug 12 + PPI Aug 13
macro_events.causal_chain: Hot CPI (≥0.3% MoM core) → Fed hawks validated → Sept hike odds spike above 60% → growth stocks sell 3-5% as rate expectations reprice → dollar surges → commodity complex weakens. Cool CPI (<0.2% MoM core) → Sept hike off the table entirely → major risk-on catalyst, Nasdaq could gap 2%+ → rotation into high-beta growth accelerates.
macro_events.analog: July 2023: CPI miss to the downside → Nasdaq rallied 3% in 2 sessions; Jan 2024: hot CPI → SPY dropped 1.5% same day
macro_events.counterargument: Market may pre-position for cool CPI given weak jobs data, meaning a meet-expectations print disappoints the bulls who already priced in dovishness.
macro_events.tickers_affected: Cool: TWLO▲ NET▲ PLTR▲ SHOP▲ | Hot: XLE▲ commodities▲ USD▲ growth▼

macro_events.event: US-Iran Diplomatic Progress — Strait of Hormuz Tensions Easing
macro_events.causal_chain: Diplomatic engagement reduces war-risk premium on VLCCs → Brent/WTI decline 4% to ~$79.80 → rerouting savings for tanker operators → lower jet fuel costs benefit airlines (DAL, UAL) → lower gasoline prices boost consumer discretionary spending power (ABNB, ETSY). Second-order: reduced geopolitical tail risk compresses VIX, supporting the RISK_ON regime.
macro_events.analog: JCPOA progress 2015 → WTI fell 15% in Q4 as Iran supply returned; Sep 2019 Abqaiq → temporary $10 spike then reversal as supply fears faded
macro_events.counterargument: Diplomacy is fragile — a single provocative action in the Strait could reverse the entire move overnight. Oil is range-bound $70-$90 and could snap back on any escalation.
macro_events.tickers_affected: DAL▲ UAL▲ ABNB▲ ETSY▲ | XOM▼ OXY▼ FRO▼

macro_events.event: Global Semiconductor Sales Record: $403B Q2 (+35% QoQ)
macro_events.causal_chain: AI infrastructure demand creating supercycle → fabs at capacity → leading-edge node pricing power for TSMC, Samsung → equipment demand surge (ASML, LRCX, AMAT). AMD Q2 revenue +50% YoY to $11.5B with data center +107% validates the AI compute thesis. Tesla/SpaceX Terafab ($16.8B) signals onshoring trend. SIA projects AI data center chips could reach $1.2T annual revenue by 2028.
macro_events.analog: 2017-2018 memory supercycle → MU and LRCX doubled before peaking; current AI cycle is broader-based and potentially longer-duration
macro_events.counterargument: AMD stock fell 1.2% despite the massive beat — the bar is extremely high. Semicap spending could peak if hyperscaler capex moderates in 2027. Tariff risk on China-bound chips remains.
macro_events.tickers_affected: NVDA▲ AVGO▲ ASML▲ LRCX▲ AMD➜ (beat but sold — high bar)
